notes.title: Steam Release and Gumroad Link
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Thank you so much for checking out this game! As you can probably already tell, it's release day for the Steam version of this game. This game is also available on Gumroad (link posted below), for those who would prefer that. Just a warning though, the Gumroad version WILL NOT support updates, or at least not as often as the Steam version will. 

I hope you all enjoy the game! Thank you to the wonderful people on Kickstarter who made this project possible!

GUMROAD DOWNLOAD: https://gum.co/YRlWx

-Samantha Arehart
